records.notes: Visible forms show وَلِتُنذِرَ in Hafs/Warsh/Qalun/Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi and وَلِيُنذِرَ in Shu'bah.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰيَٰتِهِۦ while the other editions show ءَايَٰتِهِۦ, an edition presentation difference in the initial alif/hamza form.
The visible lexical form فالق is consistent; Warsh/Qalun show dagger-alif presentation فَٰلِقُ while the other editions show فَالِقُ.
The visible lexical form حُسبان is consistent; Warsh/Qalun show dagger-alif and stopping-mark presentation differences in حُسۡبَٰناٗۖ versus حُسۡبَانٗاۚ.
The visible lexical form أعناب is consistent; Warsh/Qalun show dagger-alif presentation in اَعۡنَٰبٖ versus the other editions' أَعۡنَابٖ.
